heroHeadline: Denmark Warns Russia Could Attack NATO Member Within Months in Strongest European Assessment Yet
heroSubtitle: Danish intelligence issued a warning that Russia could attack a NATO member country within months — a significantly stronger assessment than prior European warnings, which had focused on sabotage without flagging imminent conventional military attack. The Danish assessment marks a notable escalation in official threat language from a NATO frontline state.
footerNote: Data sourced from official NATO/SHAPE and member-state defense ministry statements, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
